## R Markdown


```{r}
library(sf) # Handling shapefiles 
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

```



```{r}

# Loading the data
gii <- read_csv("homework/wk4/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",na = c("NULL"),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))

# Extracting the columns of interest 


gii_10_19 <- gii %>% select(iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019)


gii_10_19 <- gii_10_19 %>% 
  mutate(diference_10_19 = gii_2010 - gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(ISO2 = countrycode(iso3, origin = "iso3c", destination = "iso2c"))


```
Adding the data to the world
```{r}
countries <- st_read("homework/wk4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
```
```{r}
joined <- countries %>%
  left_join(gii_10_19, by = c("ISO" = "ISO2"))
```



```{r}
joined %>% st_write("homework/wk4/World_Countries_v3.gpkg")
```
